narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Contextual Evidence -> Expert Profile -> Research Method -> Closing Questions
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and summarize the research of sociologist Ashley Mears regarding the 'party girl' phenomenon in high-end nightlife. It challenges the superficial perception of young women enjoying a 'free' luxurious lifestyle by exposing the underlying structures of unpaid labor and exploitation where their presence is used as a form of currency for club promotion and social status.
